A '''blaster pistol model''' existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. The [[Blaster/Legends|blaster's]] body was a simple box shape, with a wooden grip lacking a trigger guard, and a long skinny barrel. The [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] fired [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Laser/Legends|lasers]] and was very accurate. The pistol was favored among [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and some [[Lumini pirates/Legends|Lumini Pirates]]. In addition, the weapon found it's way into the service of the [[Officer/Legends|officers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], as well as [[Vehicle Command Crewer|Imperial vehicle pilots]] and [[TIE pilot]]s, and found some use in the hands of [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]]. The weapon also found its way into the hands of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] officers by the year [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].

==Behind the scenes==
The blaster pistol model appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' and its expansion pack ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''. The weapon would be dropped by pistol wielding enemies, but could not be used by the player. Picking up the weapon would result in the player adding ammunition to his stores. In ''Mysteries of the Sith'' the weapon would change into a [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]] upon being dropped, with the exception of walker pilots, who would drop an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] instead of their pistol.
